name: toro-term-planner
description: TŌRO sub-plugin — the free hook. Parents forward school newsletters, Hero notifications, sports WhatsApps, dance recital emails to term-<whanau-id>@toro.nz and get back a term-shaped plan: calendar events, payments, gear lists, permission slips, RSVPs, holiday transitions. NZ-specific knowledge layer covers Ministry of Education term dates, OSCAR providers, Hero/Seesaw/Skool Loop conventions, and the rhythms of NZ state, integrated, and private schools. Builds on the existing agentmail-inbound newsletter parser.
